{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check that conversion worked
print("Revenue converted successfully.")
print("Sample revenue after conversion:\\n", sales_df['revenue'].head(5))

# Now filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
new_paid_search = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
    (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Check the subset
print("\nNumber of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH:", len(new_paid_search))

# Calculate the fraction that converted
converted_count = new_paid_search['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(new_paid_search)
fraction_converted = converted_count / total_count

print("Converted count:", converted_count)
print("Total count:", total_count)
print("Fraction converted:", fraction_converted)"}
